sql.asset_lock: SELECT storage_key FROM n_media_assets WHERE media_id=:media_id AND owner_user_id=:user_id AND access_scope='chat' AND status='ready' FOR UPDATE
sql.asset_free: SELECT 1 FROM n_media_assets a WHERE a.media_id=:media_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_chat_message_media cm WHERE cm.media_id=a.media_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_post_media pm WHERE pm.media_id=a.media_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_direct_message_media dm WHERE dm.media_id=a.media_id)
sql.query_message: SELECT message_id FROM n_direct_messages WHERE conversation_id=:conversation_id AND message_id=:message_id AND is_deleted=0
sql.add_reaction: MERGE INTO n_direct_message_reactions r USING (SELECT :message_id AS message_id,:user_id AS user_id,:emoji AS emoji FROM dual) i ON (r.message_id=i.message_id AND r.user_id=i.user_id AND r.emoji=i.emoji) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (message_id,user_id,emoji) VALUES (i.message_id,i.user_id,i.emoji)
sql.remove_reaction: DELETE FROM n_direct_message_reactions WHERE message_id=:message_id AND user_id=:user_id AND emoji=:emoji
sql.list_media: SELECT l.message_id,a.media_id,a.owner_user_id,a.media_type,a.file_name,a.public_url,a.file_size,a.mime_type,a.width,a.height,a.duration,a.thumbnail_url,a.alt_text,a.description,a.status,a.created_at,a.updated_at FROM JSON_TABLE(:message_ids,'$[*]' COLUMNS (message_id NUMBER PATH '$')) ids JOIN n_direct_message_media l ON l.message_id=ids.message_id JOIN n_media_assets a ON a.media_id=l.media_id AND a.status='ready' AND a.access_scope='chat' ORDER BY l.message_id,l.position
sql.list_replies: SELECT r.message_id,parent.message_id AS reply_id,parent.content AS reply_content,NVL(u.display_name,u.username) AS reply_author_name FROM JSON_TABLE(:message_ids,'$[*]' COLUMNS (message_id NUMBER PATH '$')) ids JOIN n_direct_message_replies r ON r.message_id=ids.message_id JOIN n_direct_messages origin ON origin.message_id=r.message_id JOIN n_direct_messages parent ON parent.message_id=r.reply_to_message_id AND parent.conversation_id=origin.conversation_id AND parent.is_deleted=0 JOIN n_users u ON u.user_id=parent.sender_id
sql.list_reactions: SELECT r.message_id,r.emoji,COUNT(*) AS reaction_count,MAX(CASE WHEN r.user_id=:viewer_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reacted_by_me FROM JSON_TABLE(:message_ids,'$[*]' COLUMNS (message_id NUMBER PATH '$')) ids JOIN n_direct_message_reactions r ON r.message_id=ids.message_id GROUP BY r.message_id,r.emoji ORDER BY r.message_id,r.emoji
sql.private_media_read:
SELECT a.storage_key, a.access_scope
FROM n_media_assets a
JOIN n_users owner ON owner.user_id = a.owner_user_id
JOIN n_users viewer ON viewer.user_id = :viewer_id
WHERE a.media_id = :media_id
  AND a.status = 'ready'
  AND a.access_scope IN ('chat', 'post')
  AND owner.is_active = 1 AND owner.status = 'active'
  AND viewer.is_active = 1 AND viewer.status = 'active'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM n_user_blocks b
    WHERE (b.user_id = viewer.user_id AND b.target_user_id = owner.user_id)
       OR (b.user_id = owner.user_id AND b.target_user_id = viewer.user_id)
  )
  AND (
    (owner.user_id = viewer.user_id
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_chat_message_media cm WHERE cm.media_id = a.media_id)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_post_media pm WHERE pm.media_id = a.media_id)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_direct_message_media d WHERE d.media_id=a.media_id))
    OR (a.access_scope = 'chat' AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM n_chat_message_media cm
      JOIN n_chat_messages m ON m.message_id = cm.message_id AND m.author_id = owner.user_id
      JOIN n_chat_channels c ON c.channel_id = m.channel_id AND c.group_id = m.group_id
      JOIN n_groups g ON g.group_id = c.group_id
      JOIN n_group_members gm ON gm.group_id = g.group_id AND gm.user_id = viewer.user_id
      WHERE cm.media_id = a.media_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND c.is_deleted = 0
        AND g.is_active = 1 AND g.is_deleted = 0
        AND gm.status IN ('active', 'muted')
        AND (c.is_private = 0 OR gm.role IN ('owner', 'admin', 'moderator'))
    ))
    OR (a.access_scope = 'chat' AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM n_direct_message_media l JOIN n_direct_messages m ON m.message_id=l.message_id AND m.sender_id=owner.user_id
      JOIN n_direct_conversations c ON c.conversation_id=m.conversation_id
      WHERE l.media_id=a.media_id AND m.is_deleted=0 AND c.is_deleted=0
        AND viewer.user_id IN (c.user_low_id,c.user_high_id)
    ))
    OR (a.access_scope = 'post' AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM n_post_media pm
      JOIN n_posts p ON p.post_id = pm.post_id AND p.author_id = owner.user_id
      WHERE pm.media_id = a.media_id AND p.is_deleted = 0
        AND p.visibility IN ('private', 'followers', 'mentioned')
        AND fn_can_view_post(viewer.user_id, p.post_id) = 1
    ))
  )
sql.any_extras_table_present: SELECT 1 FROM user_tables WHERE table_name IN ('N_DIRECT_MESSAGE_MEDIA','N_DIRECT_MESSAGE_REPLIES','N_DIRECT_MESSAGE_REACTIONS') AND ROWNUM=1
